messages:
Samir: Quick check — crossfunc eng/product sync cadence and agenda ownership. Our RFC reviews and design review slots keep getting bumped. Can we try a weekly agenda steward rotation (one person owns agenda + run) and a firm 30m slot for quick triage?

Anya: +1 for a steward rota. weekly sounds fine if steward keeps it tight. Suggest agenda template so handoffs are easy. :thumbsup:

Mohit: Are we sure 30m will be enough? When RFCs land they need ~15-20m. Maybe 45m every other week?

Elena: I like weekly 30m + ability to extend to 45m if there's an RFC flagged "design review" in the agenda. We can require RFCs to add a 1-slide summary in the thread.

Kai: Proposal: steward picks items, marks priority (A/B/C), ensures decision owner and follow-ups logged in Decision Log. If time runs out, steward assigns follow-up owner and adds to next agenda.

Anya: Agenda template (suggested):
```
- 3m: quick status (what blocked)
- 12m: A-priority discussions (RFCs/designs)
- 10m: B-priority updates / ops notes
- 5m: decisions & action owners + add to decision log
```

Samir: That template works. Can we run a quick poll for steward volunteers and preferred cadence (weekly 30m vs biweekly 45m)? I can create a Doodle / calendar poll.

calendar-bot: Poll created: https://doodle.com/poll/xYz123 (vote by EOD Thu). Calendar invite will be auto-proposed after poll closes.

Mohit: I'll vote for biweekly 45m but happy to steward occasionally.

Elena: Voting now. Also +1 on the 1-slide RFC summary requirement — saves time.

Anya: I'll volunteer to steward the first week to kick things off and demo adding items to Decision Log.

Samir: Awesome — @Anya you're up for week 1. @Mohit can take week 2 if biweekly wins, otherwise rotate. I'll update the Decision Log with a new heading "Crossfunc sync (agenda stewards)" and add the stewardship checklist.

Kai: Minor ask: can we add a PR checkbox in the agenda thread: "PR ready for review? (link)" — helps with quick code-review pings.

Anya: Good call. I'll add that to the template and the steward checklist.

Samir: Ok plan: run poll -> finalize cadence by Fri -> add calendar recurring event + steward rota in Decision Log -> steward to post agenda by Mon morning each week. Thanks all. :rocket:
